arxiv-2005-14576.title: Harbsafe-162 – A Domain-Specific Data Set for the Intrinsic Evaluation of Semantic Representations for Terminological Data
arxiv-2005-14576.creator: Susanne Arndt, M. A, Dieter Schnäpp, M. A
arxiv-2005-14576.description: Abstract The article presents Harbsafe-162, a domain-specific data set for evaluating distributional semantic models. It originates from a cooperation by Technische Universität Braunschweig and the German Commission for Electrical, Electronic & Information Technologies of DIN and VDE, the Harbsafe project.

arxiv-2012-10334.title: Atomic-scale imaging of laser-driven electron dynamics in solids using subcycle-resolved x-ray-optical wave mixing
arxiv-2012-10334.creator: Daria Popova-Gorelova, Robin Santra
arxiv-2012-10334.description: Abstract We investigate laser-driven electron dynamics in solids on the atomic scale and in real space within Floquet formalism, and develop a method based on subcycle-resolved x-ray-optical wave mixing to reconstruct those dynamics. We analyze how time-reversal and inversion symmetries influence properties of optically-induced charge distributions and microscopic electron currents.

arxiv-2105-05812.title: Ultrafast charge-transfer dynamics in twisted MoS 2 /WSe 2 heterostructures
arxiv-2105-05812.creator: J. E. Zimmermann, M. Axt, F. Mooshammer, P. Nagler, C. Schüller, T. Korn, U. Höfer, G. Mette
arxiv-2105-05812.description: Abstract Two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMD) offer a unique platform for creating van-der-Waals heterojunctions with fascinating physical properties and promising applications in optoelectronics and valleytronics. Because of their typical type-II band alignment, photoexcited electrons and holes can separate via interfacial charge transfer.

arxiv-2212-04715.title: Monopoles, vortices and their correlations in SU( 3 3 ) gauge group
arxiv-2212-04715.creator: N. Karimimanesh, S. Deldar, Z. Asmaee
arxiv-2212-04715.description: Abstract Topological defects such as monopoles, vortices and “chains”of the SU( 3 3 ) gauge group are studied using its SU( 2 2 ) subgroups. Two appropriate successive gauge transformations are applied to the subgroups to identify the chains of monopoles and vortices.

arxiv-2307-03919.title: Common terms of generalized Pell and Narayana’s cows sequences
arxiv-2307-03919.creator: Bibhu Prasad Tripathy, Bijan Kumar Patel
arxiv-2307-03919.description: Abstract For an integer k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 , let { P n ( k ) } n \{P_{n}^{(k)}\}_{n} be the k k -generalized Pell sequence which starts with 0 , … , 0 , 1 0,\dots,0,1 ( k k terms) and each term afterwards is the sum of k k preceding terms.

arxiv-2308-12293.title: Six Bits
arxiv-2308-12293.creator: A. J. S. Hamilton
arxiv-2308-12293.description: Abstract The spinors of the group Spin ⁡ ( N ) {\rm Spin}(N) of rotations in N N spacetime dimensions are indexed by a bitcode with [ N / 2 ] [N/2] bits. A well-known promising grand unified group that contains the standard-model group is Spin ⁡ ( 10 ) {\rm Spin}(10) .

arxiv-2311-18730.title: Mavericks at ArAIEval Shared Task: Towards a Safer Digital Space - Transformer Ensemble Models Tackling Deception and Persuasion
arxiv-2311-18730.creator: Sudeep Mangalvedhekar, Kshitij Deshpande, Yash Patwardhan, Ravindra Murumkar
arxiv-2311-18730.description: Abstract In this paper, we highlight our approach for the "Arabic AI Tasks Evaluation (ArAiEval) Shared Task 2023". We present our approaches for task 1-A and task 2-A of the shared task which focus on persuasion technique detection and disinformation detection respectively. Detection of persuasion techniques and disinformation has become imperative to avoid distortion of authentic information.

arxiv-2402-17750.title: Scaling on-chip photonic neural processors using arbitrarily programmable wave propagation
arxiv-2402-17750.creator: Tatsuhiro Onodera 1,2,∗ , Martin M. Stein 1,∗ , Benjamin A. Ash 1 , Mandar M. Sohoni 1 , Melissa Bosch 1 , Ryotatsu Yanagimoto 1,2 , Marc Jankowski 2,3 , Timothy P. McKenna 2,3 , Tianyu Wang 1,† , Gennady Shvets 1 , Maxim R. Shcherbakov 1,‡ , Logan G. Wright 1,2,§ , Peter L. McMahon 1,4 1 School of
arxiv-2402-17750.description: Abstract On-chip photonic processors for neural networks have potential benefits in both speed and energy efficiency but have not yet reached the scale at which they can outperform electronic processors. The dominant paradigm for designing on-chip photonics is to make networks of relatively bulky discrete components, such as Mach–Zehnder interferometers and microring resonators, connected by one-dimensional waveguides.

arxiv-2404-18784.title: Where on Earth Do Users Say They Are?: Geo-Entity Linking for Noisy Multilingual User Input
arxiv-2404-18784.creator: Tessa Masis (they/them), Brendan O’Connor
arxiv-2404-18784.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tessa Masis (they/them), Brendan O’Connor. Geo-entity linking is the task of linking a location mention to the real-world geographic location. In this paper we explore the challenging task of geo-entity linking for noisy, multilingual social media data. There are few open-source multilingual geo-entity linking tools available and existing ones are often rule-based, which break easily in social media settings, or LLM-based, which are too expensive for large-scale datasets.

arxiv-2412-03323.title: Generation of Tunable Correlated Frequency Comb via Four-Wave-Mixing in Optical fibers
arxiv-2412-03323.creator: Aryan Bhardwaj, Debanuj Chatterjee, Ashutosh Kumar Singh, Anil Prabhakar
arxiv-2412-03323.description: Abstract We report an all-fiber-based experimental setup to generate a correlated photon-pair comb using Four Wave Mixing (FWM) in Highly non-linear- fiber (HNLF). Temporal correlations of the generated photons were confirmed through coincidence measurements. We observed a maximum of 32 kcps, with a coincidence to accidental ratio of 17 ± 1 17\pm 1 .

arxiv-2505-07564.title: Topological characterization of Hopfions in finite-element micromagnetics
arxiv-2505-07564.creator: Louis Gallard, Riccardo Hertel
arxiv-2505-07564.description: Abstract Topological magnetic structures, such as Hopfions, are central to three-dimensional magnetism, but their characterization in complex geometries remains challenging. We introduce a robust finite-element method for calculating the Hopf index in micromagnetic simulations of three-dimensional nanostructures. By employing the Biot-Savart form for the vector potential, our approach ensures gauge-invariant results, even in multiply connected geometries like tori.

arxiv-2509-14450.title: On the equivalence and optimality of transformations of diffusive systems
arxiv-2509-14450.creator: Davide Gabrielli, Giovanni Jona-Lasinio
arxiv-2509-14450.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Davide Gabrielli, Giovanni Jona-Lasinio. In this paper we introduce, inspired by Clausius and developing the ideas of [ 11 ] , the concept of equivalence of transformations in non equilibrium theory of diffusive systems within the framework of macroscopic fluctuation theory.

arxiv-2510-25658.title: Optical excitations in nanographenes from the Bethe-Salpeter equation and time-dependent density functional theory: absorption spectra and spatial descriptors
arxiv-2510-25658.creator: Maximilian Graml, Jan Wilhelm
arxiv-2510-25658.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maximilian Graml, Jan Wilhelm. The GW plus Bethe-Salpeter equation ( GW -BSE) formalism is a well-established approach for calculating excitation energies and optical spectra of molecules, nanostructures, and crystalline materials. We implement GW -BSE in the CP2K code and validate the implementation for a standard organic molecular test set, obtaining excellent agreement with reference data, with a mean absolute error in excitation energies below 3 meV. We then study optical spectra of nanographenes of increasing length, showing excellent agreement with experiment.

britannica-1911-augurs.title: Augurs (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-augurs.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-augurs.description: Article 'Augurs' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The early history of the college is obscure. Its institution has been attributed to Romulus or Numa. It probably consisted originally of three members, of whom the king himself was one. This number was doubled by Tarquinius Priscus, but in 300 B.C. it was only four, two places, according to Livy (x.

europmc-pmc3016705.title: Event-related potential: An overview.
europmc-pmc3016705.creator: Sur S, Sinha VK.
europmc-pmc3016705.description: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides an excellent medium to understand neurobiological dysregulation, with the potential to evaluate neurotransmission. Time-locked EEG activity or event-related potential (ERP) helps capture neural activity related to both sensory and cognitive...

plos-pone-0329042.title: Risk factors for decline in estimated glomerular filtration rate amongst Malawian adults living in rural Karonga: Protocol for a prospective cohort study using cystatin C- and creatinine-based eGFR
plos-pone-0329042.creator: Charlotte M Snead, Chimwemwe Mkandawire, Paul Kambiya, Shekinah Munthali-Mkandawire, Fredrick Kalobekamo, Albert Dube, Thandile Nkosi-Gondwe, Baltazar Bananga Mtenga
plos-pone-0329042.description: Risk factors for decline in estimated glomerular filtration rate amongst Malawian adults living in rural Karonga: Protocol for a prospective cohort study using cystatin C- and creatinine-based eGFR

pmc-10476779.title: Association of baseline serum cholesterol with benefits of intensive blood pressure control
pmc-10476779.creator: Xiaoqi Wang, Yingqing Feng, Li Yang, Guohui Zhang, Xiaoyuan Tian, Qianhui Ling, Jiangshan Tan, Jun Cai
pmc-10476779.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background:Intensive systolic blood pressure (SBP) control improved outcomes in the Strategy of Blood Pressure Intervention in the Elderly Hypertensive Patients (STEP) trial. Whether baseline serum lipid parameters influence the benefits of intensive SBP control is unclear.Methods:The STEP trial was a randomized controlled trial that compared the effects of intensive (SBP target of 110 to <130 mmHg) and standard (SBP target of 130 to <150 mmHg) SBP control in Chinese patients aged 60 to 80 years with hypertension.

pmc-10518314.title: Recent global increase in multiple rapid intensification of tropical cyclones
pmc-10518314.creator: N D Manikanta, Sudheer Joseph, C V Naidu
pmc-10518314.description: The rapid intensification (RI ≥ 30 knots/24-h) of tropical cyclones (TCs) makes TC forecasting difficult, resulting in severe damage to property and life. Forecasting can get even worse if TCs have experienced RI more than once (referred to as "multiple-RI TCs") in their lifetime.

pmc-10598884.title: Iron(II)-Catalyzed Activation of Si–N and Si–O Bonds Using Hydroboranes
pmc-10598884.creator: Mirela
pmc-10598884.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). We report the activation and functionalization of Si–N bonds with pinacol borane catalyzed by a three-coordinate iron(II) β-diketiminate complex. The reactions proceed via the mild activation of silazanes to yield useful hydrosilanes and aminoboranes. The reaction is studied by kinetic analysis, along with a detailed investigation of decomposition pathways using catecholborane as an analogue of the pinacol borane used in catalysis.

pmc-11437799.title: The effectiveness of music in improving the recovery of cardiothoracic surgery: a systematic review with meta-analysis and trial sequential analysis
pmc-11437799.creator: Tianying Li, Yani Guo, Dan Lyu, Jingyi Xue, Mingwei Sheng, Lili Jia, Xin Jin, Wenli Yu, Yiqi Weng, Yuli Wu
pmc-11437799.description: AimThis study aimed to compile data on the effectiveness of music therapy for patients undergoing cardiothoracic surgery.BackgroundAfter cardiac and thoracic surgery, patients often experience physiological and psychological complications, such as anxiety, pain, stress, depression and changes in vital signs, which have a great impact on prognosis.

pmc-11712690.title: Type 2 diabetes and Alzheimer's disease share common cortical neurodegenerative patterns
pmc-11712690.creator: Mahboubeh Motaghi, Olivier Potvin, Simon Duchesne
pmc-11712690.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundType 2 diabetes (T2D) is a prevalent health condition associated with cognitive impairment and dementia. T2D induces adverse effects not only on the pancreas but also on the liver, kidneys, muscles, fat cells, and, notably, the brain. Both T2D and Alzheimer's disease (AD) exhibit associations with neurodegeneration, yet the extent of their shared patterns of brain atrophy remains poorly understood, potentially indicating common pathways.

pmc-11934898.title: Feasibility planning study of lattice radiotherapy for palliation in bulky tumors
pmc-11934898.creator: Jayashree NP, Shreekripa Rao, Anshul Singh, Umesh Velu, Ankita Mehta, Shirley Lewis
pmc-11934898.description: PurposeLattice radiotherapy can potentially deliver high doses to the tumor core, while conventional doses to the periphery resulting in improved response rates in large tumors (> 5 cm). We assessed the feasibility of planning lattice radiotherapy and dosimetrically compared it with conventional radiotherapy.

pmc-12080358.title: Perıostın and fıbronectın ın nasal lesıons: key players ın polyps and ınverted papıllomas
pmc-12080358.creator: Mehmet Birinci, Oğuzhan Okçu, Tuğba Yemiş, Oğuz Gül, Suat Terzi, Metin Çeliker, Özlem Çelebi Erdivanlı, Tolga Mercantepe, Levent Tümkaya, Başar Erdivanlı, Engin Dursun
pmc-12080358.description: Background: Sinonasal lesions are common benign masses with overlapping clinical and histopathological features. Extracellular matrix proteins such as periostin, fibronectin, and tenascin-C play key roles in tissue remodeling and inflammation, yet their distinct expression profiles in these lesions remain poorly defined.

pmc-12470735.title: Right Ventricular Strain in Healthy Children: Insights from Speckle-Tracking Echocardiography
pmc-12470735.creator: Renée S Joosen, Eva A M Meulblok, Esther H Mauritz-Fuite, Martijn G Slieker, Johannes M P J Breur, Thomas Brand, Daniel A Morris
pmc-12470735.description: Background: Right ventricular (RV) strain using two-dimensional speckle tracking is a reliable and clinically significant tool for detecting RV systolic dysfunction, but it varies by age, vendor, and software. Objectives: To establish pediatric age-specific normal values and Z-score equations for biventricular strain using GE Healthcare equipment and software.

pmc-12766166.title: Terahertz-range on-chip local oscillator based on Josephson junction arrays for superconducting quantum-limited receivers
pmc-12766166.creator: Fedor V Khan, Lyudmila V Filippenko, Andrey B Ermakov, Mikhail Yu Fominsky, Valery P Koshelets
pmc-12766166.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In this paper we present the results of the development, fabrication, measurements, and analysis of terahertz-range oscillators based on Josephson junction arrays embedded into the central electrode of a coplanar line. The influence of array geometry, the presence of a matched load at the nonradiating edge, and the magnitude of the tunneling current density of Josephson junctions on such oscillator characteristics as radiation power, linewidth, and operating range are discussed. Various options are suggested for further improvement of the oscillator performance.

pmc-13039755.title: Diverse regulation of functional dimerization of a sugar transporter by different interfacial lipids
pmc-13039755.creator: Yan Zhang, Weijing Zhao, Mojie Duan, Yang Shen, Jianping Li, Huayong Xie, Qiong Tong, Yongxiang Zhao, Jun Yang
pmc-13039755.description: Endogenous lipids play essential roles in modulating membrane protein structure and function, yet the molecular mechanisms governing lipid-specific regulation remain elusive. Here, we combine solid-state NMR spectroscopy and molecular dynamics simulations to elucidate how distinct lipids regulate the structure and activity of a membrane protein in a native-like membrane environment.

pmc-13219184.title: Antibody–drug conjugates in colorectal cancer: molecular design, preclinical advances, and translational challenges
pmc-13219184.creator: Md Arif Ansari, Md Abubakar, Mohd Mazharuddin Ansari, Nabeeha Koya, Janmejay Gupta, Maria Aazam, Sonali Sandeep Shinde, Sana Ahmed, Amita Rai, Krishna Murti, Biplab Pal, Sachchida Nand Rai, Palwinder Kaur, Smita Shenoy, Nitesh Kumar
pmc-13219184.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related morbidity and mortality worldwide, largely because of tumor heterogeneity, therapeutic resistance, and the limited efficacy of existing targeted therapies in advanced disease. Antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs) have emerged as a promising class of targeted anticancer therapeutics that combine the specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the cytotoxic potency of highly active payloads, thereby enabling selective tumor cell killing while minimizing systemic toxicity.

pmc-13281871.title: Mechanisms and Emerging Strategies to Overcome Immunotherapy Resistance in Cold Tumours of Colorectal Cancer
pmc-13281871.creator: Xinqiang Zhu, Beibei Ge, Linchun Wen

pmc-13343773.title: An unexpected sequel to happiness: happy heart syndrome
pmc-13343773.creator: Laith Rhabneh, Jamil Wafi, Ra’ed Ababneh, Shahd Qaddour, Mohammed Aloqaily, Abdel Rahman Alwardat, Khalid Hazaimeh
pmc-13343773.description: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy (TCM) is characterized by transient regional systolic dysfunction without obstructive coronary artery disease. A rare subtype, happy heart syndrome (HHS), is triggered by positive emotional events. A 65-year-old woman with hypertension, diabetes mellitus, and dyslipidemia presented with typical anginal chest pain for three days, beginning after attending a wedding party.

pmc-13640120.title: Nursing students’ attitudes toward technology-enhanced psychomotor skill learning: scale development and validation using a mixed-methods approach
pmc-13640120.creator: Tuğçe Kabak Solak, Afife Yurttaş
pmc-13640120.description: BackgroundThe integration of information technologies into nursing education has increased significantly, particularly in the teaching of psychomotor skills. Although these technologies provide important learning opportunities, students’ attitudes toward their use play a critical role in the effectiveness of technology-enhanced education.

pmc-13677027.title: Identification of platelet-derived biomarker in a cohort of Parkinson's disease
pmc-13677027.creator: Zhao-Ying Dong, Yu Xiang, Ling Wang, Yu Ai, Xin-Yi Du, Yuan-Yuan Sun, Zhi-Hao Lin, Tong-Fei Liu, Jian-Bo Pan, Jian-Wen Deng, Ping Li, Yang Zhao, Kai Li, Yun-Chuang Sun, Zhi-Fei Zhang, Hong-Yong Wang, Xiao-Han Li, Yong Yan, Yong-An Sun, Ou-Mei Cheng, Guo-Jun Chen
pmc-13677027.description: Evidence has suggested that platelets (PLTs) share biochemical properties with neurons. However, whether PLTs might serve as biomarkers of Parkinson's disease (PD) remains uncertain. In this study, we first analyzed RNA data from a publicly available microarray of the substantia nigra (SN) and RNA-seq data from the PLTs of newly recruited PD patients using weighted gene coexpression network analysis (WGCNA).
